limitations: Five selected known abbreviations, not a random sample and not five independent observations. Sole and duplu share one cell.
Editorial expansions were known before visual checking; this is not blind recovery.

The catalogue is not a complete diplomatic transcription: the lower band visibly includes Iuppiter between intervals, omitted by the editorial lower-band list. Do not use that entire list as an exact gold sequence.
The twelve zodiac headings have an independently published order, but their compressed written forms were not transcribed with sufficient certainty here and are excluded from these five cases.
No model, hidden key, inference on Voynich, or statistical performance claim.
